items.stem: Which TWO are true of the Java Streams API?

options.text: A stream pipeline is not executed until a terminal operation runs
options.rationale: Correct: intermediate operations are lazy; terminal operations trigger execution.

options.text: A stream cannot be reused after a terminal operation
options.rationale: Correct: streams are single-use; a new stream is needed to re-process.

options.text: Streams always mutate the source collection
options.rationale: Streams generally do not mutate the source.
Parallelism is opt-in via parallelStream(), not automatic.

items.explanation: Correct: intermediate operations are lazy; terminal operations trigger execution.
